parts.name: Translation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the translation blade of a utility knife, made of stainless steel. It is a thin, sharp component designed for cutting.
parts.Functional_description: The blade performs the cutting function. It can be extended or retracted through a sliding mechanism for safety and precision.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the body of the knife, sliding in and out for use or storage.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of a utility knife, made of durable ABS plastic. It houses the blade and provides grip and control.
parts.Functional_description: The base body supports the blade mechanism, provides a handle for the user, and includes a slider for blade adjustment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main structural and ergonomic component of the knife.
